resolution.title: Remove unused YANG model imports
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it
Remove 41 unused import statements across 35 YANG model files, as identified in #25395.

Each removal was verified by confirming the imported prefix is not referenced anywhere in the file.

Note: `sonic-acl.yang` was listed in #25395 as having an unused `sonic-extension` import, but this import does not exist in the current master branch (likely already removed).

#### How I did it
Removed the unused `import` blocks (including their `prefix` declarations) from YANG files in `src/sonic-yang-models/yang-models/`.

The unused imports span 12 modules:
- `sonic-types` (7 files)
- `sonic-port` (5 files)
- `sonic-extension` (14 files — 15 listed minus sonic-acl.yang which was already clean)
- `ietf-inet-types` (2 files)
- `ietf-yang-types` (3 files)
- `sonic-interface` (2 files)
- `sonic-vrf` (2 files)
- `sonic-portchannel` (2 files)
- `sonic-bgp-common` (1 file)
- `sonic-dscp-tc-map` (1 file)
- `sonic-tc-priority-group-map` (1 file)
- `sonic-tc-queue-map` (1 file)

#### How to verify it
```bash
# Verify no removed prefix is used in any modified file:
cd src/sonic-yang-models/yang-models
for f in *.yang; do
  # Extract all prefixes from import blocks
  grep -oP "prefix\s+\K\S+(?=;)" "$f" | while read p; do
    # Check if prefix is used outside import blocks
    count=$(grep -c "${p}:" "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    if [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then
      echo "UNUSED: $p in $f"
    fi
  done
done
```

Fixes #25395
